name: buffer-linkovne
description: A separate Buffer connection for Linkovne social media, drafts, publishing and analytics.

interface.longDescription: Manage Linkovne's connected social channels through the official Buffer MCP server. Read the queue, prepare drafts and ideas, schedule requested posts and check performance. Uses a dedicated OAuth connection so Linkovne remains separate from other Buffer accounts.
interface.defaultPrompt: Show my Linkovne channels and upcoming Buffer posts.
